verses.en: And it came to pass, when all the kings which were on this side Jordan, in the hills, and in the valleys, and in all the coasts of the great sea over against Lebanon, the Hittite, and the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard thereof;
verses.pt: E aconteceu que quando ouviram estas coisas todos os reis que estavam desta parte do Jordão, tanto nas montanhas como nas planícies, e em toda a costa do grande mar diante do Líbano, os heteus, amorreus, cananeus, perizeus, heveus, e jebuseus;
verses.en_web: When all the kings who were beyond the Jordan, in the hill country, and in the lowland, and on all the shore of the great sea in front of Lebanon, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard of it
verses.en_bbe: Now on hearing the news of these things, all the kings on the west side of Jordan, in the hill-country and the lowlands and by the Great Sea in front of Lebanon, the Hittites and the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites,

verses.en: That they gathered themselves together, to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord.
verses.pt: Juntaram-se em unidade, de um acordo, para lutar contra Josué e Israel.
verses.en_web: they gathered themselves together to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord.
verses.en_bbe: Came together with one purpose, to make war against Joshua and Israel.

verses.en: And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done unto Jericho and to Ai,
verses.pt: Mas os moradores de Gibeão, quando ouviram o que Josué havia feito a Jericó e a Ai,
verses.en_web: But when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and to Ai,
verses.en_bbe: And the men of Gibeon, hearing what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai,

verses.en: They did work wilily, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks upon their asses, and wine bottles, old, and rent, and bound up;
verses.pt: Eles usaram também de astúcia; pois foram e fingiram-se embaixadores, e tomaram sacos anciãos sobre seus asnos, e odres anciãos de vinho, rasgados e remendados,
verses.en_web: they also resorted to a ruse, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks on their donkeys, and old, torn-up and bound up wine skins,
verses.en_bbe: Acting with deceit, got food together as if for a long journey; and took old food-bags for their asses, and old and cracked wine-skins kept together with cord;

verses.en: And old shoes and clouted upon their feet, and old garments upon them; and all the bread of their provision was dry and mouldy.
verses.pt: E sapatos velhos e remendados em seus pés, com roupas velhas sobre si; e todo aquele pão que traziam para o caminho, seco e mofado.
verses.en_web: and old and patched shoes on their feet, and wore old garments. All the bread of their food supply was dry and moldy.
verses.en_bbe: And put old stitched-up shoes on their feet, and old clothing on their backs; and all the food they had with them was dry and broken up.

verses.en: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal, and said unto him, and to the men of Israel, We be come from a far country: now therefore make ye a league with us.
verses.pt: Assim vieram a Josué ao acampamento em Gilgal, e disseram-lhe a ele e aos de Israel: Nós viemos da terra muito distante: fazei, pois, agora conosco aliança.
verses.en_web: They went to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, and said to him and to the men of Israel, “We have come from a far country. Now therefore make a covenant with us.”
verses.en_bbe: And they came to Joshua to the tent-circle at Gilgal, and said to him and to the men of Israel, We have come from a far country: so now make an agreement with us.

verses.en: And the men of Israel said unto the Hivites, Peradventure ye dwell among us; and how shall we make a league with you?
verses.pt: E os de Israel responderam aos heveus: Talvez vós habiteis em meio de nós: como pois poderemos nós fazer aliança convosco?
verses.en_web: The men of Israel said to the Hivites, “What if you live among us? How could we make a covenant with you?”
verses.en_bbe: And the men of Israel said to the Hivites, It may be that you are living among us; how then may we make an agreement with you?

verses.en: And they said unto Joshua, We are thy servants. And Joshua said unto them, Who are ye? and from whence come ye?
verses.pt: E eles responderam a Josué: Nós somos teus servos. E Josué lhes disse: Quem sois vós e de onde vindes?
verses.en_web: They said to Joshua, “We are your servants.” Joshua said to them, “Who are you? Where do you come from?”
verses.en_bbe: And they said to Joshua, We are your servants. Then Joshua said to them, Who are you and where do you come from?

verses.en: And they said unto him, From a very far country thy servants are come because of the name of the LORD thy God: for we have heard the fame of him, and all that he did in Egypt,
verses.pt: E eles responderam: Teus servos vieram de muito distantes terras, pela fama do SENHOR teu Deus; porque ouvimos sua fama, e todas as coisas que fez em Egito,
verses.en_web: They said to him, “Your servants have come from a very far country because of the name of Yahweh your God; for we have heard of his fame, all that he did in Egypt,
verses.en_bbe: And they said to him, Your servants have come from a very far country, because of the name of the Lord your God: for the story of his great name, and of all he did in Egypt has come to our ears,

verses.en: And all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites, that were beyond Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, which was at Ashtaroth.
verses.pt: E tudo o que fez aos dois reis dos amorreus que estavam da outra parte do Jordão; a Seom rei de Hesbom, e a Ogue rei de Basã, que estava em Astarote.
verses.en_web: and all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon and to Og king of Bashan, who was at Ashtaroth.
verses.en_bbe: And what he did to the two kings of the Amorites east of Jordan, to Sihon, king of Heshbon, and to Og, king of Bashan, at Ashtaroth.

verses.en: Wherefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spake to us, saying, Take victuals with you for the journey, and go to meet them, and say unto them, We are your servants: therefore now make ye a league with us.
verses.pt: Pelo qual nossos anciãos e todos os moradores de nossa terra nos disseram: Tomai em vossas mãos provisão para o caminho, e ide ao encontro deles, e dizei-lhes: Nós somos vossos servos, e fazei agora conosco aliança.
verses.en_web: Our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spoke to us, saying, ‘Take supplies in your hand for the journey, and go to meet them. Tell them, “We are your servants. Now make a covenant with us.”’
verses.en_bbe: So the responsible men and all the people of our country said to us, Take food with you for the journey and go to them, and say to them, We are your servants: so now make an agreement with us.

verses.en: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and it is mouldy:
verses.pt: Este nosso pão tomamos quente de nossas casas para o caminho o dia que saímos para vir a vós; e ei-lo aqui agora que está seco e mofado:
verses.en_web: This our bread we took hot for our supplies out of our houses on the day we went out to go to you; but now, behold, it is dry, and has become moldy.
verses.en_bbe: This bread which we have with us for our food, we took warm and new from our houses when starting on our journey to you; but now see, it has become dry and broken up.

verses.en: And these bottles of wine, which we filled, were new; and, behold, they be rent: and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey.
verses.pt: Estes odres de vinho também os enchemos novos; ei-los aqui já rasgados: também estes nossas roupas e nossos sapatos estão já velhos por causa do muito longo caminho.
verses.en_web: These wine skins, which we filled, were new; and behold, they are torn. These our garments and our shoes have become old because of the very long journey.”
verses.en_bbe: And these wine-skins were new when we put the wine in them, and now they are cracked as you see; and our clothing and our shoes have become old because of our very long journey here.

verses.en: And the men took of their victuals, and asked not counsel at the mouth of the LORD.
verses.pt: E os homens de Israel tomaram de sua provisão do caminho, e não perguntaram à boca do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: The men sampled their provisions, and didn’t ask counsel from Yahweh’s mouth.
verses.en_bbe: And the men took some of their food, without requesting directions from the Lord.

verses.en: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a league with them, to let them live: and the princes of the congregation sware unto them.
verses.pt: E Josué fez paz com eles, e estabeleceu com eles que lhes deixaria a vida: também os príncipes da congregação lhes juraram.
verses.en_web: Joshua made peace with them, and made a covenant with them, to let them live. The princes of the congregation swore to them.
verses.en_bbe: So Joshua made peace with them, and made an agreement with them that they were not to be put to death: and the chiefs of the people took an oath to them.

verses.en: And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a league with them, that they heard that they were their neighbours, and that they dwelt among them.
verses.pt: Passados três dias depois que fizeram com eles o concerto, ouviram como eram seus vizinhos, e que habitavam em meio deles.
verses.en_web: At the end of three days after they had made a covenant with them, they heard that they were their neighbors, and that they lived among them.
verses.en_bbe: Now three days after, when they had made this agreement with them, they had word that these men were their neighbours, living near them.

verses.en: And the children of Israel journeyed, and came unto their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjath-jearim.
verses.pt: E partiram-se os filhos de Israel, e ao terceiro dia chegaram a suas cidades: e suas cidades eram Gibeão, Quefira, Beerote, e Quiriate-Jearim.
verses.en_web: The children of Israel traveled and came to their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath Jearim.
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Israel went forward on their journey, and on the third day came to their towns. Now their towns were Gibeon and Chephirah and Beeroth and Kiriath-jearim.

verses.en: And the children of Israel smote them not, because the princes of the congregation had sworn unto them by the LORD God of Israel. And all the congregation murmured against the princes.
verses.pt: E não os feriram os filhos de Israel, porquanto os príncipes da congregação lhes haviam jurado pelo SENHOR o Deus de Israel. E toda a congregação murmurava contra os príncipes.
verses.en_web: The children of Israel didn’t strike them, because the princes of the congregation had sworn to them by Yahweh, the God of Israel. All the congregation murmured against the princes.
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Israel did not put them to death, because the chiefs of the people had taken an oath to them by the Lord, the God of Israel. And all the people made an outcry against the chiefs.

verses.en: But all the princes said unto all the congregation, We have sworn unto them by the LORD God of Israel: now therefore we may not touch them.
verses.pt: Mas todos os príncipes responderam a toda a congregação: Nós lhes juramos pelo SENHOR Deus de Israel; portanto, agora não lhes podemos tocar.
verses.en_web: But all the princes said to all the congregation, “We have sworn to them by Yahweh, the God of Israel. Now therefore we may not touch them.
verses.en_bbe: But all the chiefs said to the people, We have taken an oath to them by the Lord, the God of Israel, and so we may not put our hands on them.

verses.en: This we will do to them; we will even let them live, lest wrath be upon us, because of the oath which we sware unto them.
verses.pt: Isto faremos com eles: lhes deixaremos viver, para que não venha ira sobre nós por causa do juramento que lhes fizemos.
verses.en_web: We will do this to them, and let them live; lest wrath be on us, because of the oath which we swore to them.”
verses.en_bbe: This is what we will do to them: we will not put them to death, for fear that wrath may come on us because of our oath to them.

verses.en: And the princes said unto them, Let them live; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water unto all the congregation; as the princes had promised them.
verses.pt: E os príncipes lhes disseram: Vivam; mas sejam lenhadores e carregadores de água para toda a congregação, como os príncipes lhes disseram.
verses.en_web: The princes said to them, “Let them live, so they became wood cutters and drawers of water for all the congregation, as the princes had spoken to them.”
verses.en_bbe: Keep them living, and let them be servants, cutting wood and getting water for all the people. And all the people did as the chiefs had said to them.

verses.en: And Joshua called for them, and he spake unto them, saying, Wherefore have ye beguiled us, saying, We are very far from you; when ye dwell among us?
verses.pt: E chamando-os Josué, lhes falou dizendo: Por que nos enganastes, dizendo, Habitamos muito longe de vós; uma vez que morais em meio de nós?
verses.en_web: Joshua called for them, and he spoke to them, saying, “Why have you deceived us, saying, ‘We are very far from you,’ when you live among us?
verses.en_bbe: Then Joshua sent for them, and said to them, Why have you been false to us, saying, We are very far from you, when you are living among us?

verses.en: Now therefore ye are cursed, and there shall none of you be freed from being bondmen, and hewers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God.
verses.pt: Vós pois agora sois malditos, e não faltará de vós servo, e quem corte a lenha e tire a água para a casa de meu Deus.
verses.en_web: Now therefore you are cursed, and some of you will never fail to be slaves, both wood cutters and drawers of water for the house of my God.”
verses.en_bbe: Now because of this you are cursed, and you will for ever be our servants, cutting wood and getting water for the house of my God.

verses.en: And they answered Joshua, and said, Because it was certainly told thy servants, how that the LORD thy God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you, therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you, and have done this thing.
verses.pt: E eles responderam a Josué, e disseram: Quando foi dado a entender a teus servos, que o SENHOR teu Deus havia mandado a Moisés seu servo que vos havia de dar toda a terra, e que havia de destruir todos os moradores da terra diante de vós, por isto temos muito medo de vós por nossas vidas, e fizemos isto.
verses.en_web: They answered Joshua, and said, “Because your servants were certainly told how Yahweh your God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you. Therefore we were very afraid for our lives because of you, and have done this thing.
verses.en_bbe: And, answering Joshua, they said, Because it came to the ears of your servants that the Lord your God had given orders to his servant Moses to give you all this land, and to send destruction on all the people living in it, because of you; so, fearing greatly for our lives because of you, we have done this.

verses.en: And now, behold, we are in thine hand: as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us, do.
verses.pt: Agora pois, eis-nos aqui em tua mão; o que te parecer bom e correto fazer de nós, faze-o.
verses.en_web: Now, behold, we are in your hand. Do to us as it seems good and right to you to do.”
verses.en_bbe: And now we are in your hands: do to us whatever seems good and right to you.

verses.en: And so did he unto them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, that they slew them not.
verses.pt: E ele o fez assim; que os livrou da mão dos filhos de Israel, para que não os matassem.
verses.en_web: He did so to them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, so that they didn’t kill them.
verses.en_bbe: So he kept them safe from the children of Israel, and did not let them be put to death.

verses.en: And Joshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation, and for the altar of the LORD, even unto this day, in the place which he should choose.
verses.pt: E constituiu-os Josué aquele dia por lenhadores e carregadores de água para a congregação e para o altar do SENHOR, no lugar que ele escolhesse: o que são até hoje.
verses.en_web: That day Joshua made them wood cutters and drawers of water for the congregation and for Yahweh’s altar to this day, in the place which he should choose.
verses.en_bbe: And that day Joshua made them servants, cutting wood and getting water for the people and for the altar of the Lord, in the place marked out by him, to this day.
